description: 212 m² private house interior design by DUMSKAYA DESIGN. Technical documentation, custom furniture, photorealistic 3D visualization and comprehensive turnkey renovation.
h1: Private House Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation, 212 m²

blocks.text: Private House Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation, 212 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed and completed a comprehensive interior project for a 212 m² private house. The project combined interior design, technical documentation, custom-made furniture and comprehensive turnkey renovation.

The design covers all key areas of the house, including the living room, bedrooms, children’s room, kitchen with integrated appliances, entrance hall, bathrooms and functional storage systems. The layout and interior solutions were developed as a unified concept focused on ergonomics, functionality and comfortable everyday living.

Custom-made furniture was designed and manufactured specifically for the project. The kitchen, built-in wardrobes, shelving and storage systems were developed according to the architecture of the house, room dimensions and functional requirements. This approach allowed the furniture to become an integral part of the interior while maximizing the efficient use of available space.

Before implementation, a detailed estimate was prepared covering construction and finishing works, materials, custom furniture, household appliances, sanitary equipment, lighting and other elements specified in the project. Following the design stage, a comprehensive turnkey renovation was completed in accordance with the developed technical documentation.
The project also included photorealistic 3D visualizations, allowing the future interior, materials, furniture, colour combinations and lighting solutions to be evaluated before implementation.

This 212 m² private house project demonstrates DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s comprehensive approach to residential interiors — from interior design and technical documentation to custom furniture production and complete turnkey implementation.
